### Managing Mistreatment
Author: Charles R. Swindoll
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/todays-insight-chuck-swindoll/today-s-insight-february-15-2013.html
Passage: 1 Peter 3:15
Points:
- While many can endure deserved punishment, believers are uniquely called to handle mistreatment after doing what is right.
- When facing undeserved suffering, we can rest knowing God is present, good, and in control.
- Setting apart Christ as Lord means yielding the situation to His authority rather than reacting rashly.
- Believers honor Christ by relying on His grace to stay calm, control their emotions, and let integrity stand as their defense.

### Always Be Ready to Give an Answer
Author: Adrian Rogers
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/loveworthfinding/love-worth-finding-november-25-2018.html
Passage: 1 Peter 3:15
Points:
- Believers are called to always be prepared to articulate the reason behind their faith.
- Apologetics does not mean apologizing for beliefs, but offering a reasoned defense of the truth.
- Demonstrating faith through good conduct is vital, but Christians must also be ready to explain it verbally.
- Being prepared requires studying Scripture to understand core doctrines concerning sin, salvation, heaven, and hell.
